purpose: Cross-runtime retry policy for operations that may create durable or externally visible effects.

read_only.notes: No mutation effect exists. Transport/request retry is outside the mutation-outcome contract.

proven_pre_effect_failure.notes: Retry is legal only when evidence proves execution did not cross the effect boundary.

requirements: receiver atomically binds mutation key to durable effect/result
same key with different mutation content is rejected
dedupe survives process restart and request-cache expiry
concurrent same-key attempts cannot both create the effect
fresh observation can distinguish effect-present from effect-absent before another mutation
no reliable read-back and no durable same-key resend contract
heuristic duplicate suppression must not be treated as receiver-durable idempotency

cua.guarded_browser_click.reason: target state can be re-observed; acknowledgement loss must not trigger another fresh click

supersync.operation_upload.reason: Operation.id is durable; same-id/same-content resend dedupes and same-id/different-content is rejected

hermes.foreground_terminal_command.reason: after process spawn an arbitrary shell command may have external effects with no generic read-back

hermes.ambiguous_final_delivery.reason: platform may have received the complete message but blind resend can duplicate it

wger.log_set_duplicate_window.reason: read-before-write window can race, expires, and lacks a stable caller mutation key
